meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给画面加上推拉、缩放与运镜关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在视频合成里做镜头运动或关键帧动画。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-ins, zooms, and camera-move keyframes to a composition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need camera moves or keyframe animation inside video compositions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写「关键帧」动效:推入拉出、变焦、重构构图、运镜等,用 GSAP、CSS 等实现,再用 lint、check、keyframes 命令出图验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉、变焦、运镜等 2D/3D 关键帧动效时接管;不负责整体场景策划、品牌设计、素材采购等。

say.text: 给这段合成加一个从 1.0 推到 1.4 的推入关键帧,结尾保持住。
say.note: 生成带缓动的推入关键帧并定格结尾。

say.text: 用 GSAP 写一套 seek 安全的变焦关键帧。
say.note: 写在已注册的可 seek 时间线上,便于渲染验证。

say.text: 跑 hyperframes keyframes 诊断,并出一张关键帧快照。
say.note: 输出诊断结果和指定时间点的快照图。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude authors seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: punch-ins, zoom, reframe, camera moves, GSAP/CSS/Anime.js motion, then verifies with lint, check, keyframes and shots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom, reframe or camera keyframes. It doesn't cover scene strategy, brand design or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe from 1.0 to 1.4 and hold the final pose.
say_en.note: Creates an eased punch-in and holds the last frame.

say_en.text: Write seek-safe zoom keyframes in GSAP.
say_en.note: Registers them on the seek-safe timeline for verification.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes diagnostics and snapshot the key poses.
say_en.note: Prints diagnostics plus snapshots at chosen times.
